items.title: Bitcoin and ethereum prices today, Tuesday, August 25, 2026: Highest opening for bitcoin in over three months
items.summary: Bitcoin opened at $78,982.27 on Tuesday, August 25, 2026, 1.6% higher than Monday's opening price. As of 8:17 a.m. ET, the price of bitcoin rose further  to $79,038.31.
